outcome_integrity_policy: Before any matrix access, this manifest fixes each direct URL, filename, and byte count. Independently verified SHA-256 values also bind the four inspected non-outcome barcode and feature files. The two outcome-matrix SHA-256 values remain unknown until authorized acquisition. The prepare step rejects any pinned hash, filename, or size mismatch, computes SHA-256 for every acquired file while reading it, and binds those hashes in source_acquisition.json and the immutable reducer bundle used by predict and score.
